_comment: TradeBeast config. Copy to config.json and edit. All paths support ~ and $VAR. Any server can be disabled with enabled=false or with the TRADEBEAST_DISABLE_<name>=1 environment variable. Bitget needs real credentials in the environment (BITGET_API_KEY / BITGET_SECRET_KEY / BITGET_PASSPHRASE) and is skipped automatically when they are absent. Kronos is skipped automatically when its local server does not answer /health.

bitget.comment: Optional. Requires BITGET_API_KEY, BITGET_SECRET_KEY and BITGET_PASSPHRASE in the environment. Never put keys in this file.

kronos.comment: Optional. Exposes kronos_forecast / kronos_health only when the local Kronos server answers /health. The model itself (~200MB) is never bundled.
